question: Establish the previously unmeasured, fixed SmolVLM-500M starting AnswerF1 before any local FIT adaptation, so subsequent same-carrier changes can be attributed relative to an observed starting point.
necessity: No real same-carrier quality score exists; metadata and failed synthetic E admission do not supply this baseline.
The result separates original authors' pretrained capability/size from any future proposed adaptation gain.
This is a fixed descriptive origin, with neither a score admission threshold nor a positive-retain/negative-discard model selection rule.
protocol_edits_by_reviewer: Replaced per-question high-score capability wording with observed fixed-set performance; prohibited choosing routes/modules from those scores.
Made native loading-key/error rejection explicit; no ignored keys or backend change to continue.
Made the independent monotonic watchdog and own PID/startticks/UID/isolated-PGID termination boundary explicit.
implementation_requirements: Separate minimal inference entry and independent source review; no invocation of closed E/Q/R entry, make_method, training or CPU gradient admission.
Reuse pinned asset hashes and fixed native BF16/vision-eager/text-SDPA/input/template/generation policy; ambiguity, loading incompatibility or input overflow stops the attempt.
Exactly the original 100 DEV IDs/references and task generation budgets; full input/image provenance, state/layout before-after, actual weight/storage counts and process resource/cost records.
Only complete sealed output is scored once; partial output remains incomplete, and STARTED failure/interruption/timeout has no resume, extension or automatic v2.
limits: An individual correct response is not a certified stable capability; low initial score does not establish that 87-step adaptation is hopeless.
The already explored DEV is not an unseen holdout; this is neither RW/RS evidence nor proof that native Down replaces experts.
Native pretrained scale and quality belong to the model authors, not this research method.
The closed native E/Q/R implementations remain closed; this review does not authorize their repair or resurrection.
review_execution: Only new protocol text was read/edited and this review written using the standard library; no model/module/Torch/tensor/QA/GPU/scoring was run.
